name: no-invented-last-week
why: Ashley, 17 Nov 2026, a profile started the day before: told on his way to the gym that he had 'killed 70kg for 8 reps last week' on a trap bar deadlift he had never done (the prompt's own worked example, copied). Day 2 of the plan: yesterday's sets are logged, the trap bar has never been. The coach may give today's 72.5kg as the weight to start at and check; it must never claim a past trap bar lift, a 'last week' or a 'last session' on it. The app also takes such a sentence out of the reply (past-performance.ts), so a breach here means the model tried; the judge marks honesty.
